status.not_connected: Notion not connected for this account

rail.empty: Paste a Notion link to pin it here. Saved pages appear in the chat @ picker.

embed.hint: If the embed is blank, Notion may block framing — use Open in Notion.

hub.title: Open Notion in a new tab
hub.lead: Notion’s main app blocks embedding in Multica (browser security). Use Open in Notion for full pages, pin links on the left for @mentions, and connect Notion so agents can search via MCP.
hub.hint: Public notion.site share links can still embed here when available.
